ortak.cevrimdisi: No internet connection — changes cannot be saved.

tasarim.aciklama: Drag and drop fields to arrange the form. Changes stay in the draft; users are unaffected until you publish.
tasarim.paletAciklama: Drag onto the canvas to add. Drag a field back here to remove it.
tasarim.alanSecin: Select a field on the canvas to see its settings.
tasarim.gizliAciklama: The field is not shown to users, but the default value below is still submitted. To drop it entirely, drag it back to the palette.
tasarim.saltOkunurKilitli: This value is generated by the program; it is always read-only.
tasarim.kaldirilamaz: This field is required for saving and cannot be removed.
tasarim.yayinlandi: Design published; users now see this layout.
tasarim.yayinOnayMesaj: This layout will apply to all users. The previous version is archived and can be restored.

satinalma.kaydetHenuzYok: Form data is ready — the ERP save (SOHOM_SIPARIS_KAYDET) will be wired in the next step.

dogrulama.enAzBirSatir: At least one request line is required.
dogrulama.aciklamaUzun: Description may be at most 200 characters.
dogrulama.hakkindaUzun: About may be at most 3072 characters.
dogrulama.adresUzun: Delivery address may be at most 200 characters.

anasayfa.aciklama: Access your ERP operations from the left menu.
anasayfa.bosDurum: The Purchase Request module will be here soon.

sql.aciklama: Test and Live connection definitions for the ERP MSSQL server. Stored procedures run against the active environment.
sql.sifreNotu: Leave blank to keep the saved password.
sql.aktifOrtamAciklama: Applies to all users: ERP writes (stored procedure calls) go to the selected environment's database.
sql.testSecimAciklama: Writes go to the test database — safe to experiment.
sql.canliSecimAciklama: Writes go to the production ERP database.
sql.canliOnayMesaj: From now on ALL writes will go to the production ERP database. Are you sure you want to continue?

dogrulama.portGecersiz: Port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
dogrulama.sifreZorunlu: Password is required on first save.

hata.DOGRULAMA: There are errors in the submitted data.
